item.title: Opinion: From Reagan Republicans to MAGA politics
item.description: The subject matter of this letter might upset some folks, but I think it needs to be said. Sometimes the truth hurts.

item.title: Retreat on Lake Lanier brings grieving mothers together
item.description: On the shores of Lake Lanier, grieving mothers will soon gather for a weekend centered on something many have struggled to find since losing their children: connection with others who truly understand their pain.

item.title: Opinion: NIL, transfers threaten the future of college football
item.description: This avid fan has followed college football since 1952. With spring practice upon us, it’s an ideal time to assess how greed is jeopardizing this grand game.

item.title: Your weekly guide of things to do in and around Hall County
item.description: From art classes and historical forums to expos and food festivals, there's plenty of unique events in and around Hall County to add to your calendar this week. Here are our top five picks.

item.title: ‘Jason loved these students’: Family of North Hall teacher killed in prank gone wrong wants charges dropped
item.description: The family of North Hall High School math teacher Jason Hughes, who was killed in a tragic accident Friday night, is asking for the charges to be dropped against the five students involved in the prank gone wrong.

item.title: What a new local ‘pro-law enforcement’ group says about planned ICE detention center in Oakwood
item.description: Nancy Steptoe believes her newly created Facebook page, Stand With ICE Hall County, is more than about supporting ICE.

item.title: Family of student charged in North Hall teacher’s death expresses ‘deepest sorrow’ in statement
item.description: The family of a North Hall High School student charged with vehicular homicide in the accidental death of beloved North Hall High School math teacher Jason Hughes expressed its “deepest sorrow” in a statement to The Times on Monday.

item.title: Update: Here’s how Oakwood City Council voted on resolution urging pause on planned ICE detention center
item.description: Oakwood is “evaluating all legal options available” concerning a planned ICE detention center.

item.title: Hall County Golf Championships: Lakeview Academy boys, Gainesville girls lead after Day 1 at Chattahoochee
item.description: Final round scheduled for Tuesday in Gainesville

item.title: ‘Everybody loved him’: North Hall High teacher Jason Hughes remembered for his kindness, faith after tragic accident
item.description: Jason Hughes, a beloved North Hall High School teacher who died in a tragic accident Friday night, is being remembered for his kindness, compassion and faith.
